arm.assignment: sha256(salt || game_id), deterministic and recomputable from logs alone
arm.population: incomplete-information negotiation games where we make the round-1 opening offer

why_this_arm_exists: The production policy emits one deterministic price per value cell. Every observational comparison of prices therefore collapses into a comparison of different game cells, and four separate candidate improvements died on exactly that confound. Exploration buys the price variation that makes the demand curve estimable at all; it is not justified by any claimed effect.

prespecified_analysis.primary_estimand: expected normalized payoff per opening, as a function of demanded markup
prespecified_analysis.unit_of_analysis: one game, never one turn and never one rejection
prespecified_analysis.unit_ration: Per-rejection aggregation double-counts long games -- a single long bargaining game contributes about 6.5 rejection rows -- and empirically inverts the sign of the effect. Measured 2026-08-26: +0.159 pot per rejection versus -0.012 pot per game for the same rule.
prespecified_analysis.pooling: Pool all cells and fit markup as the covariate. Per-cell argmax is FORBIDDEN: simulated at the planned traffic it overstates the acceptance rate by +0.106 (p90 +0.168) even when every rung is truly identical, and the winning rung is uniform over all ten.

selection_and_estimation_must_be_split.rule: Choose the deployment price on the first half of the exploration window; estimate its value only on the untouched second half.
selection_and_estimation_must_be_split.rationale: In-sample argmax reports a phantom gain that barely shrinks with sample size: simulated +0.0325 at 125 draws per rung and still +0.0183 at 800, against a true gain of +0.009. Split-sample recovered +0.0086 to +0.0090 at every size.
selection_and_estimation_must_be_split.consequence: More data does not fix in-sample selection. Only the split does.

prespecified_analysis.monotonicity: Acceptance is non-increasing in price. Report the isotonic (pool-adjacent-violators) fit alongside the raw rungs so a non-monotone blip is visible as noise rather than read as structure.
prespecified_analysis.replication_requirement: The chosen price must win on at least 3 of 4 independent held-out days before deployment. Same-day-only results are not promotable.

prespecified_null_result: If the isotonic fit is flat within its confidence band, or the chosen price fails held-out replication, the finding is NO EFFECT and the exploration arm is switched off. A flat curve is a valid and expected outcome, not a reason to slice further.
forbidden: reporting an in-sample selected effect size
aggregating by turn or by rejection instead of by game
adding cells, splits, or covariates after seeing the curve
re-running with a different ladder and reporting the better of the two

overfitting_provenance.lesson: Five of five observational candidates evaporated under a correct unit, a confounding check, or held-out replication. The prior on any new observational finding from these logs should be low, and this plan is written to make a null result cheap to accept.
